title_en: Doctors and Pharmacies (7/20): Xiao Zhang's Prescription
note_en: With 把, the object comes before the verb, and 都 can then sum it up: 她把每种药的说明书都拿出来 "she took out the leaflet for every one of the drugs." 都 always looks back at a group that has already been mentioned, so it has to come after 每种药的说明书, never before it as English "all" can.
